# CANDIDATE: GAP_UP_VWAP_FAIL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Gaps up ≥0.3% that lack institutional support (price fails to stay above VWAP by 10:00 EST) tend to reverse as liquidity fills the gap. This edge exists because weak gap-ups attract stop-loss orders and short-seller interest when VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance, creating mean-reversion pressure.

## Mechanism

Entry: If open > prior close × 1.003 (gap up ≥0.3%) AND price at 10:00 EST < VWAP AND EMA8 < EMA21 (bearish ribbon) AND no higher high since open (no BOS up), enter short at 10:00 bar close.  
Exit: Chart-stop at gap high (invalidation), TP1 at prior close (gap fill), runner trail 12% off HWM.  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX between 12-22 and time between 09:45-10:30 EST; avoid FOMC/earnings windows.
